name: Heisa Byouin
source:
I can't be late for Houjou's checkup, so...
I tried to slip past Shima, but she spotted me right away.
"Hosokawa-san, is it really okay for you to be wandering out of the pharmacy and slacking off?"
That's her way of saying hi.
"Don't say stuff that makes me look bad."
"So where are you headed?"
"I'm going for my health check."
"Oh yeah, today's the staff physicals."
"You done already?"
"I haven't had time! We've had two internal medicine surgeries since this morning-it's been chaos!"
Shima let out a big sigh.
She acts like she runs the whole ward or something.
But actually, Shima's just the lowest-ranked nurse on staff, so there's no way they'd let her anywhere near an operation.
"You're ten minutes late!"
When I walked into the exam room, right away, Miss Houjou's irritated voice hit me.
I glanced at the clock on the wall. 2:10. Crap.
I clicked my tongue in my head.
Getting here took way longer than I thought.
Everyone at the hospital knew Miss Houjou was a stickler for time.
Just being alone in a room with her, someone I can't stand, is awkward enough, but now that I'm late, I feel even more self-conscious about it.
I kind of blamed Shima for talking so much and making me late.
"Hurry up and sit down!"
Miss Houjou snapped coldly.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20021218055819fw_/http://www.visit.co.jp/titles/ps1/heisabyouin.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
可不能迟到，让北条等着给我检查身体……
我试图从岛的身边溜过去，却立刻被她发现了。
“细川先生，随便从药房跑出来偷懒，真的没问题吗？”
这就是她打招呼的方式。
“别说得那么难听。”
“那你要去哪儿？”
“去做健康检查。”
“对哦，今天是员工体检。”
“你已经做完了？”
“哪有空！一早内科就来了两台手术，忙得不可开交！”
岛长叹一口气。
听这口气，还以为整个病区都归她管。
可实际上，岛只是资历最浅的护士，根本轮不到她靠近手术台。
“你迟到了十分钟！”
刚走进诊室，北条女士不耐烦的声音，便迎面砸来。
我瞥了一眼墙上的钟。两点十分。糟了。
我在心里咂了咂嘴。
过来的路上，比预想花了更多时间。
北条女士有多守时，医院里人人都知道。
和这个难以应付的人独处一室，本来就够不自在，如今又迟了到，更让我浑身不对劲。
我忍不住有些埋怨岛，都怪她话太多，害我迟到。
“还不快坐下！”
北条女士冷冷地催促道。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20021218055819fw_/http://www.visit.co.jp/titles/ps1/heisabyouin.html]官方网站[/url]]
